title: Operation Trishul Ridge: High-Altitude Hybrid Defense
briefing: Adversary has initiated multi-axis probes supported by high-power mobile EW barrage jammers and cyber disruption against automated datalinks. Forward sub-units are experiencing communication blackouts and sensor ghosting in mountain radar shadows. Sub-unit commanders must evaluate contradictory intelligence, neutralize infiltrating mechanized probes, and avoid friendly fire amidst degraded C2.

timedInjects.label: Hostile Krasukha-4 EW Jammer Spins Up
timedInjects.description: Hostile electronic warfare system targets tactical VHF nets with high-power sweep jamming.

radioAlert.text: FLASH FLASH: High-power RF noise floor elevation detected across 30-88 MHz band. Krasukha-4 emitter active on bearing 342. Switch to FHSS.

timedInjects.label: False Datalink Injection (Cyber Spoof)
timedInjects.description: Adversary cyber unit exploits unencrypted secondary transponder relay to inject phantom strike aircraft.

radioAlert.text: PRIORITY: Fast-mover track painted at Grid MH 7920 8430 altitude 7200m. Transponder code invalid. Optical spotters cannot confirm contact.

timedInjects.label: Contradictory Enemy Armor Telemetry
timedInjects.description: Forward observation post visually spots enemy tanks halted, contradicting automated radar telemetry.

radioAlert.text: OBSERVATION POST ALPHA: Hostile armor column halted in gorge defile under camouflage net! Automated datalink is reporting obsolete speed. DO NOT FIRE on blind coordinates.

timedInjects.label: Mountain Defile Radio Blackout
timedInjects.description: Charlie Company enters terrain RF shadow; tactical VHF repeater knocked out by drone strike.

radioAlert.text: COMMS ALERT: Charlie Platoon carrier lost on VHF Net 1. Unit entering radio silent defile. Uncertainty ellipse expanded.
